prompts.ember: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide cinematic environmental backdrop for an interactive card game, not card art. Create a 16:9 widescreen cinematic establishing shot that is deliberately simple, atmospheric and low-detail. Soft silhouettes, huge quiet areas of mist and tonal color, a few monumental distant forms, gentle analog film texture. Muted natural colors, beautiful restrained cinematography. Atmospheric depth and subtle lighting are the entire subject. Avoid sharp textures, crispy foliage, hyperreal details, close-up foreground objects, hard contrast, HDR, saturation, fantasy monsters, bosses, characters, buildings, text, interfaces and borders. Central lower half will be overlaid with three playing cards, so keep it quiet. Edges should be airy haze that can blend into either a light or a dark page. This is a film still composition, not a decorative travel photograph. A vast volcanic plain beneath a hazy copper sky at dusk. One distant mountain silhouette; a very fine winding ember-colored fissure below it, half-lost in drifting smoke. Soft layers of bronze, clay, apricot and smoke-grey. A warm diffused glow from the left horizon. Calm powerful elemental fire atmosphere, no dramatic eruption.
